mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_supplier_product_availability av JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_offer_id=av.supplier_offer_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss ON ss.supplier_account_site_id=o.supplier_account_site_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=ss.supplier_id SET av.orderable_yn='N',av.status_reason='이번 납품일 상품 목록에 없음',av.checked_at=NOW() WHERE ss.account_id=#{account_id} AND ss.supplier_account_site_id=#{supplier_account_site_id} AND s.supplier_code='OURHOME' AND av.delivery_date=#{delivery_date}
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ss.account_id,ss.external_site_code sold_to, SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.provider_revision,'-',1) period_group_year,SUBSTRING_INDEX(o.provider_revision,'-',-1) period_group FROM the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier s ON s.supplier_id=ss.supplier_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer o ON o.supplier_account_site_id=ss.supplier_account_site_id WHERE s.supplier_code='WELSTORY' AND ss.active_yn='Y' AND o.active_yn='Y' AND o.provider_revision REGEXP '^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}$' AND (o.valid_to IS NULL OR o.valid_to>=CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY ss.account_id,ss.external_site_code

o.decimal_order_allowed,o.product_status,o.status_reason,o.valid_from,o.valid_to,o.last_synced_at, pr.purchase_price,pr.currency,pr.effective_from price_effective_from,pr.effective_to mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer (supplier_account_site_id,supplier_product_id,delivery_type,lead_time_days,cutoff_code,cutoff_time, minimum_order_qty,order_increment_qty,decimal_order_allowed,product_status,status_reason,valid_from,valid_to, provider_revision,provider_attributes,active_yn,last_synced_at) VALUES (#{supplier_account_site_id},#{supplier_product_id},#{delivery_type},COALESCE(#{lead_time_days},0),#{cutoff_code},#{cutoff_time}, #{minimum_order_qty},#{order_increment_qty},COALESCE(#{decimal_order_allowed},'N'),COALESCE(#{product_status},'ACTIVE'), #{status_reason},#{valid_from},#{valid_to},#{provider_revision},#{provider_attributes},COALESCE(#{active_yn},'Y'),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE delivery_type=VALUES(delivery_type),lead_time_days=VALUES(lead_time_days),cutoff_code=VALUES(cutoff_code), cutoff_time=VALUES(cutoff_time),minimum_order_qty=VALUES(minimum_order_qty),order_increment_qty=VALUES(order_increment_qty), decimal_order_allowed=VALUES(decimal_order_allowed),product_status=VALUES(product_status),status_reason=VALUES(status_reason), valid_from=VALUES(valid_from),valid_to=VALUES(valid_to),provider_revision=VALUES(provider_revision), provider_attributes=VALUES(provider_attributes),active_yn=VALUES(active_yn),last_synced_at=NOW(), supplier_offer_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(supplier_offer_id)

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_price (supplier_offer_id,price_context_type,price_context_value,purchase_price,currency,tax_type,effective_from,effective_to,provider_attributes) VALUES (#{supplier_offer_id},COALESCE(#{price_context_type},'DATE'),#{price_context_value},#{purchase_price}, COALESCE(#{currency},'KRW'),#{tax_type},#{effective_from},#{effective_to},#{price_provider_attributes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE purchase_price=VALUES(purchase_price),tax_type=VALUES(tax_type),effective_to=VALUES(effective_to),observed_at=NOW()

INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_product_availability (supplier_offer_id,delivery_date,orderable_yn,status_code,status_reason,checked_at,expires_at,provider_attributes) VALUES (#{supplier_offer_id},#{delivery_date},COALESCE(#{orderable_yn},'Y'),#{availability_status_code}, #{availability_status_reason},NOW(),#{availability_expires_at},#{availability_provider_attributes}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE orderable_yn=VALUES(orderable_yn),status_code=VALUES(status_code),status_reason=VALUES(status_reason), checked_at=NOW(),expires_at=VALUES(expires_at),provider_attributes=VALUES(provider_attributes)

mapper.select: SELECT po.purchase_order_id,po.supplier_id,ss.supplier_account_site_id, poi.purchase_order_item_id,poi.account_ingredient_product_id,poi.order_qty, poi.received_order_qty,poi.base_qty_per_order_unit,poi.base_unit,poi.unit_price_snapshot, p.supplier_product_id FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id=po.purchase_order_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_ingredient_product ap ON ap.account_ingredient_product_id=poi.account_ingredient_product_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=ap.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss ON ss.account_id=po.account_id AND ss.supplier_id=po.supplier_id AND ss.external_site_code=po.sold_to WHERE po.account_id=#{account_id} AND po.client_ord=#{client_ord} AND po.sold_to=#{sold_to} AND p.supplier_id=po.supplier_id AND poi.client_ord_item=#{client_ord_item} AND p.supplier_item_code=#{supplier_item_code} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_balance (account_id,account_ingredient_product_id,location_id,current_base_qty,base_unit,current_unit, average_unit_cost,inventory_amount,last_movement_at,user_id) VALUES(#{account_id},#{account_ingredient_product_id},COALESCE(#{location_id},'L999'),#{base_received_qty},#{base_unit},#{base_unit}, #{receipt_base_unit_cost},#{receipt_amount},NOW(),#{user_id}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE average_unit_cost=CASE WHEN current_base_qty+VALUES(current_base_qty)=0 THEN 0 ELSE (inventory_amount+VALUES(inventory_amount))/(current_base_qty+VALUES(current_base_qty)) END, inventory_amount=inventory_amount+VALUES(inventory_amount), current_base_qty=current_base_qty+VALUES(current_base_qty),last_movement_at=NOW(),user_id=VALUES(user_id)
